ValidationRule.description: Status can only changed to Approved or Draft from Under Review Status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( TEXT( PRIORVALUE( CLA_Status__c ) ) = 'Under Review' , TEXT( CLA_Status__c ) <> 'Approved' , TEXT( CLA_Status__c ) <> 'Draft', TEXT( CLA_Status__c ) <> 'Under Review'
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Status can only changed to Approved or Draft from Under Review Status.
